newsitem.title: USA: MedImmune seeks human vaccine trial for HPV.
newsitem.headline: MedImmune seeks human vaccine trial for HPV.

text.p: MedImmune Inc said Wednesday it had submitted an investigational new drug application to the Food and Drug Administration for human clinical trials of its human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine.
The company said the vaccine is designed to prevent human papillomavirus disease of the genital tract.
It said the clinical trial, to be conducted at the University of Rochester Medical Center, will assess the safety and immunogenicity of the company's first HPV vaccine candidate.
HPVs are responsible for the development of genital warts and cervical cancer, it said. There are currently no vaccines to prevent these common sexually transmitted diseases, it said.
